title: MI300x workaround
summary: This project was created as a workaround for Vulkan on MI300x. Mesa 23 exposes Vulkan but starts family 0 as a graphics one. This crashes immediately on submission. Mesa 25 appears to not support this GPU at all. The workaround here is to hide the family 0 entirely from the application. Family 1 is compute-only and works fine.

title: FR: Selection in Paragraph Mode
summary: ### What problem would this feature solve? Currently selection is not allowed in Paragraph Mode. So we're not able to copy or highlight or do dictionary look up in Paragraph Mode. Platforms checked: Linux, Web, Android ### Describe the solution you'd like. Allow selection and the corresponding context menu overlay in Paragraph Mode. ### Describe workarounds you may have used to acheive the same results. Exit the Paragraph Mode to do selection and subsequent copy/highlight/etc. Then get back to Paragraph Mode. ### Additional Context One particular reason the workaround is tedious is that the paragraph mode does not continue from where we left. It start from the first paragraph. After highlighting, we have to skip several paragraphs to get to where we were.
